zh.title: 空巴上半年交付 366 架超越波音 A321neo 積壓訂單創新高
zh.summary: 空中巴士交付量領先波音的 312 架；窄體機供不應求推升二手 A321 租金至歷史高點。
body: 空中巴士公布上半年交付366架，超越波音的312架；其中 A321neo 佔交付近六成，積壓訂單突破7,100架創歷史新高。
兩家製造商皆受引擎供應與艙內件短缺影響，交付進度落後年度目標；空巴維持全年820架交付目標不變。
分析師指出，窄體機供不應求已推升二手 A321 租金至歷史高點，租賃公司議價能力明顯增強。

en.title: Airbus outpaces Boeing with 366 first-half deliveries; A321neo backlog at record
en.summary: Narrowbody scarcity pushes used-A321 lease rates to all-time highs.
body: Airbus delivered 366 aircraft in the first half against Boeing's 312, with the A321neo taking nearly 60% of deliveries and the backlog topping 7,100 — a record.
Both manufacturers trail annual targets on engine and interiors shortages; Airbus keeps its 820-delivery goal. Analysts note used-A321 lease rates at record highs as narrowbody supply stays tight.

zh.title: FAA 更新 eVTOL 適航審定規則 2027 商業空中計程車可期
zh.summary: 動力升力類操作規範與駕駛員訓練要求定案，為首批商業營運鋪路。
body: FAA 發布 eVTOL（電動垂直起降航空器）適航審定最終規則更新，明確動力升力類（powered-lift）操作規範與駕駛員訓練要求。
新規為2027年啟動商業空中計程車營運鋪路，首批適用業者包括多家已進入型別審定後期的美國新創。
ICAO 亦同步推進國際標準協調，避免各國審定規則分歧造成跨境營運障礙。

en.title: FAA finalizes updated eVTOL certification rules, clearing a 2027 launch path
en.summary: Powered-lift operating rules and pilot-training requirements are now set.
body: The FAA published its updated final rule for eVTOL airworthiness, defining powered-lift operating rules and pilot-training requirements.
The rule paves the way for commercial air-taxi launches from 2027, with several US startups deep in type certification. ICAO is coordinating international standards in parallel.

zh.title: 颱風影響東亞航線 桃園機場今取消 86 班、延誤逾 200 班
zh.summary: 民航局啟動應變機制，各航空公司開放免費改票；台北飛航情報區下午流量減少 31%。
body: 颱風外圍環流影響東亞航線，桃園機場今日取消86班、延誤逾200班；松山、高雄機場亦有零星取消。
民航局啟動颱風應變機制，各航空公司開放受影響旅客免費改票一次。FlightAware 數據顯示台北飛航情報區下午流量較平日減少31%。
氣象單位預估明日上午風雨趨緩，航班可望逐步恢復，惟機隊調度回穩仍需24至36小時。

en.title: Typhoon disrupts East Asia: 86 cancellations at Taoyuan today
en.summary: Taiwan CAA activates its typhoon response; Taipei FIR afternoon traffic down 31%.
body: Outer bands of a typhoon disrupted East Asian routes, with 86 cancellations and 200+ delays at Taoyuan; Songshan and Kaohsiung saw scattered cancellations.

Carriers are waiving one rebooking fee under the CAA's typhoon response. FlightAware shows Taipei FIR afternoon traffic down 31% on a normal day. Weather should ease by tomorrow morning, though fleet recovery may take 24–36 hours.
